stories.headline: Bessemer, Alabama traffic stop turns up nearly 60 pounds of methamphetamine
stories.summary: A stop in the 5400 block of Park Avenue South in western Jefferson County produced 27,098 grams of methamphetamine and a small amount of marijuana.

stories.headline: Ecuadorian police detain three Colombians guarding a marijuana load in Carchi near the border
stories.summary: Officers in Piartal, Montúfar, on October 10 spotted three Colombian men on two motorcycles escorting a vehicle and detained them.
